# Add Elements to HashMap

#### Course: Learn Java Intermediate

## Add Elements to HashMap

We use the put() method of the HashMap class to insert an element into a hashmap. For example,

```java
1import java.util.HashMap;
2
3class Main {
4    public static void main(String[] args) {
5
6        // create a hashmap
7        HashMap<Integer, String> students = new HashMap<>();
8
9        // add elements
10        // put() method to add elements
11        students.put(1, "Jack");
12        students.put(5, "Emily");
13        students.put(3, "Zayn");
14
15        // print students hashmap
16        System.out.println(students);
17    }
18}
```

Output

```text
{1=Jack, 3=Zayn, 5=Emily}
```

Notice the code,

```java
students.put(1, "Jack");
```

Here, we have provided both key and value as an element of the hashmap.
